title: Grandfather's Club
setting: A bright club room with many people.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Grandpa Joe
characters.look: Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan)

characters.name: Ivan
characters.look: Ivan (a broad man of about forty-five with a thick black moustache and a dark-blue police uniform)

sentences.en: Ben's grandfather invites him to his club.
sentences.zh: 本的爷爷邀请他去自己的俱乐部。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan) holds the hand of Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and waves him in at the door of a bright club room.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Grandpa Joe welcoming Ben in at the club door; the invitation itself is only suggested.

sentences.en: His grandfather has friends from many countries.
sentences.zh: 他的爷爷有来自许多国家的朋友。
sentences.scene_prompt: Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan) greets a group of friends of different looks in the club room, small flags of different countries on the tables, Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) watching.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Grandpa Joe greeting many different friends with flags on the tables; where they come from is only suggested.

sentences.en: An American woman smiles and waves at Ben.
sentences.zh: 一位美国女士微笑着向本挥手。
sentences.scene_prompt: A kind woman with a small American flag pin on her jacket smiles and waves at Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts).

sentences.en: Her son has a tiger on his shirt.
sentences.zh: 她的儿子穿着一件印着老虎的衬衫。
sentences.scene_prompt: A small boy beside the kind woman with the American flag pin wears a T-shirt with a big tiger picture.

sentences.en: A Russian man and his wife dance together.
sentences.zh: 一位俄罗斯男士和他的妻子一起跳舞。
sentences.scene_prompt: An older man and his wife dance together in the club room next to a table with a small Russian flag.
sentences.draw_note: Shows a couple dancing by a Russian flag; that they are Russian and married is only suggested.

sentences.en: Ivan, a British police officer, tells a funny story.
sentences.zh: 伊万是一位英国警官，他讲了一个有趣的故事。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ivan (a broad man of about forty-five with a thick black moustache and a dark-blue police uniform) tells a story with big gestures in the club room, Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) listening and grinning.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ivan telling a story with big gestures; the funny story itself can't be shown.

sentences.en: Everybody laughs and gives him a big smile.
sentences.zh: 每个人都笑了，并对他露出大大的笑容。
sentences.scene_prompt: Everyone in the club room laughs and smiles at Ivan (a broad man of about forty-five with a thick black moustache and a dark-blue police uniform), including Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) and Grandpa Joe (an old man, bald with a white beard, in a brown cardigan).
